intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Phuket. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: For parties and a buzzing beach stay in Patong; for families and relaxed sand choose Kata/Karon; for luxury and quiet pick Bang Tao/Laguna; for culture and cafés choose Phuket Old Town. Pick by the kind of beach you want and whether you want lively or calm.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Phuket for a first visit?
faq.a: For a lively beach and nightlife pick Patong; for nicer beaches and a calmer feel choose Kata or Karon. All three have rooms for every budget and easy access to island tours.

faq.q: Which Phuket beach is best for families?
faq.a: Kata, Karon and Kamala suit families — calmer beaches, gentler water in high season, and family-friendly resorts. Patong is busier and better for a younger crowd.

faq.q: Where to stay for quiet luxury in Phuket?
faq.a: Bang Tao and Laguna in the north have luxury resorts, beach clubs and golf, with a quiet, private feel — ideal for honeymoons or a serious rest.
